evidence.reason: The parser accepts an independent `--seed` value (line 2877), and both `drain-alive` and `drain-ambiguous` dispatch to the same `drain_refuse_phase(args)` without validating that the seed matches the phase-derived probe (lines 2895–2896). Unlike the adjacent matrix-case guard that rejects a conflicting `--boundary` because the phase name derives the case (lines 2886–2889), there is no equivalent guard for `--seed`. Thus `drain-alive --seed ambiguous` can select the ambiguous probe while the phase/evidence path remains `drain-alive`. The smallest compatible fix is to reject a conflicting seed as a usage error or derive the seed from the phase before dispatch; this is a routine correctness repair, not an owner-level behavior change.
